description: This file is a PHP class containing acceptance tests for module fields, layouts, and relationships in SuiteCRM's Module Builder environment. It utilizes the Codeception testing framework and defines test scenarios for creating fields, deploying modules, and relating records, among other functionalities.

classes.name: ModuleBuilderFieldsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for suite of module builder functionalities in SuiteCRM, including creating, editing, and deploying modules, as well as adding fields and relationships.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method run before each test, initializes fake data generator and seed.

methods.name: _after
methods.description: Cleanup method run after each test, currently empty.

methods.description: Test for creating a new module via the module builder interface.

methods.description: Test for adding a relate field to a module and editing the view layout to include it.

methods.description: Test for adding an HTML type custom field to a module and placing it in the layout.

methods.description: Test for adding an integer field to a module and placing it in the layout.

methods.name: testScenarioDeployModule
